# Agency Chief of Staff for Codex

> A content-first, outcome-owned OpenAI Codex Desktop and Codex CLI Skill. Root handles ordinary work directly; durable checklists, a separate Execution Root, role-based teams, progress, archive, and reusable knowledge are added only when they improve project execution or evidence.

Canonical Skill: `agency-chief-of-staff`, with implicit invocation enabled for project-lifecycle intent. The early-sorted `agency-discuss-plan-execute-progress-archive` entry is a two-file discovery bridge for hosts that remove Skill descriptions or omit later-sorted names under metadata-budget pressure; it forwards matching requests to the Canonical and contains no second orchestration runtime. The legacy `zhijuan-codex-agency-chief-of-staf` slug is only an explicit compatibility entry. The core runtime uses OpenAI/Codex; Claude and Fable are optional advisor extension points that are disabled by default and are not dependencies. Common discovery terms include Codex agency, Codex multi-agent orchestration, requirements discussion, execution checklist, separate Codex task, task archive, knowledge deposition, Codex Skill, Codex 幕僚长, and Codex 多 Agent 编排.

This is a curated inference-time documentation index following the emerging `llms.txt` proposal. It does not grant crawler permission, change the MIT license, prove model or host behavior, or imply that later checkout or `Unreleased` changes are published. Use the README version table, changelog, and GitHub Releases page together when answering release-status questions.

## Verification and Releases

The `v0.3.0-rc.5` documentation describes a host-scoped content-first prerelease, not stable or cross-host eligibility. v0.1's fixed heavy team is retired; v0.2 Direct Mode remains; the v0.3 lifecycle is project-intent-only, creates its complete nonexecuting Plan bundle in one deterministic call, atomically publishes the formal task directory with interrupted-index recovery, does not require every task to create a Thread, prepares Profiles Selected-only, and routes the Execution Root separately from Subagents. Live team/model/session/evidence work remains phase-gated. rc.5 retains the trace-derived fast path and adds deterministic Execution Root title requests, explicit scenario/mode guidance, and fallback/policy-parity regression gates. Native `create_thread` transport remains fail-closed and bound only to a mechanically verified user-owned source task; installed-state parity includes both content hashes and sealed permission modes.
